user.title: Add a wall display
user.description: Creates a dashboard laid out for one wall display.

data_description.name: Also sets the dashboard address, for example /wall-kitchen. It cannot be changed later.
data_description.display_device_id: Optional. The Shelly or ShellyElevate device of the display. Its area is used if you leave Area empty, its temperature and humidity sensors are shown as indoor climate, and the dashboard address is pushed to ShellyElevate.
data_description.area_id: The room the display hangs in. Its lights, covers and other devices become the home tiles. Leave empty to use the display device's area.
data_description.profile: Sets the screen size the dashboard is laid out for. Choose Custom size for other screens.
data_description.role: Room shows this room's lights, climate, media and scenes. Entrance adds house-wide status (who's home, lights left on, open doors and windows) and leave-home actions.
data_description.display_host: Optional. IP address or hostname of a ShellyElevate display that is not added to Home Assistant. Used to send it the dashboard address directly.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Shown in the status bar or info column.

custom_size.title: Custom screen size
custom_size.description: Enter the size the display's browser reports, in CSS pixels.

data_description.width: CSS pixels, not physical pixels. A 720 px wide screen at 1.5× scaling is 480 CSS px.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: The name and dashboard address stay the same.

data_description.display_device_id: Optional. The Shelly or ShellyElevate device of the display. Its area is used if you leave Area empty, its temperature and humidity sensors are shown as indoor climate, and the dashboard address is pushed to ShellyElevate.
data_description.area_id: The room the display hangs in. Its lights, covers and other devices become the home tiles. Leave empty to use the display device's area.
data_description.profile: Sets the screen size the dashboard is laid out for. Choose Custom size for other screens.
data_description.display_host: Optional. IP address or hostname of a ShellyElevate display that is not added to Home Assistant. Used to send it the dashboard address directly.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Shown in the status bar or info column.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name with at least one letter or digit.
error.url_path_taken: A dashboard or panel with this address already exists. Choose another name.
error.area_required: Choose an area, or a display device that has an area.
error.area_not_found: This area no longer exists. Choose another one.

abort.already_configured: A wall display with this name is already set up.

data_description.scene_buttons: Up to 2 scenes or scripts, shown first on the Scenes page.
data_description.role: Room shows this room's lights, climate, media and scenes. Entrance adds house-wide status (who's home, lights left on, open doors and windows) and leave-home actions.
data_description.pages: Pages next to Home in the bottom navigation.
data_description.idle_seconds: Seconds without touch before the display goes back to Home. 0 turns this off.
data_description.kiosk: Built-in hides the header and sidebar on this dashboard only. Kiosk-mode plugin leaves this to the kiosk-mode HACS plugin. Off shows the normal Home Assistant interface.
data_description.pinned: Shown first, in this order. Can be from any room.
data_description.max_home_tiles: At most this many tiles on Home; the last one becomes "+N more" when there are more. 0 shows as many as fit.
data_description.include_display_entities: Off: the display device's own lights, switches and relays don't become tiles. Pin one to show it anyway.
data_description.climate_entities: Optional. Can be from any room. Shown on the Climate page instead of the room's climate entities; the first is the main thermostat.
data_description.temperature_entity: Optional. The room temperature on the room card, the Climate page and the navigation. Empty: the area's temperature sensor, else the display's own.
data_description.humidity_entity: Optional. The room humidity on the room card and the Climate page. Empty: the area's humidity sensor, else the display's own.
data_description.show_in_sidebar: List the dashboard in the Home Assistant sidebar.

options.shelly_x2_landscape: Shelly Wall Display X2 / X2i, landscape
options.shelly_x2_portrait: Shelly Wall Display X2 / X2i, portrait

viewport_mismatch.title: Display size differs from the chosen model

confirm.title: Display size differs from the chosen model
confirm.description: The dashboard for {name} was laid out for {profile}, but the display reports {measured}. Submit to lay it out for the measured size instead.

empty_room.title: {name} has nothing to show
empty_room.description: The area {area} of the wall display {name} has no lights, covers, climate, media players or scenes the dashboard can show, so its Home page only shows the clock and weather. Assign devices to the area, or reconfigure the display to use another area.

url_path_taken.message: The address /{url_path} is already used by another dashboard or panel. Remove that dashboard or panel, then reload this entry.

generate_failed.message: Could not build the dashboard for {name}. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
